# Vendored dependency

`sha256.js`: js-sha256 **0.11.1**, unmodified source (LF, final newline).
Author: Chen, Yi-Cyuan. License: MIT; see LICENSE.js-sha256.txt.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emn178/js-sha256/v0.11.1/src/sha256.js

SHA-256 of this source file:
`f3d043dcc7b164ff6d476483324dd10def5c9c4758745981cec093d5b4694fe2`

Used only for incremental SHA-256 of original file bytes. Browser deployment
requires neither npm nor a CDN. Tests run the browser implementation without
Node crypto present and compare it to an independent Node digest.
